summary_en: LITALICO raised its FY2027 annual dividend forecast from 20 yen to 20 yen per share, with the interim dividend remaining 0 yen and the year-end dividend increased from 15 yen to 20 yen, supported by upward revisions to operating profit guidance to 5.8–6.3 billion yen on stronger-than-expected domestic employment support operations and U.S. facility performance.
title_en: Notice Regarding Revision of Consolidated Earnings Forecast and Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase) for Fiscal Year Ending March 2027
translation_en_brief:
LITALICO Inc. raised its dividend forecast for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027. The annual dividend per share remains 20 yen, consisting of an interim dividend of 0 yen (unchanged) and a year-end dividend increased from 15 yen to 20 yen. This revision follows an upward adjustment to full-year consolidated earnings guidance.

The company revised operating profit guidance upward to a range of 5.8–6.3 billion yen, from the previous forecast of 5.5 billion yen. This improvement reflects stronger-than-expected performance in domestic employment support operations, driven by higher occupancy rates at existing facilities, and the contribution of newly operational U.S. facilities that were not incorporated into the initial forecast.

Management emphasized that the dividend increase reflects the company's basic policy of balancing aggressive growth investment with stable dividend growth. The decision factors include cash generation from business activities, anticipated funding needs for future growth investments, and financial soundness. The company noted that actual profit increases may fluctuate depending on the timing and scale of additional investments and the performance trajectory of U.S. facilities, which is why the revised guidance is presented as a range rather than a point forecast.
